opening.text: I've had diarrhea or I've been going to the toilet more often, and I have a fever. My muscles ache all over, and since this started I've noticed unusual bleeding or bruising. In the last 4 weeks I travelled to West Africa. In the last month I've been in contact with someone infected with Ebola, and in the past 2 weeks I've been around someone with similar symptoms.
